title.title: Solid Wood FJL Boards by Indospace group
title.description:
We'll take you to our behind the scene process of our FJL boards from solid wood. Our finger-joint laminated (FJL) boards are crafted from smaller wood pieces that would otherwise go to waste, making it more environmentally friendly. Manufactured in-house CNC machine to deliver outstanding stability and offers a smooth surface—ideal for a wide range of applications, from furniture making to construction projects. Available in 4 sizes: 15mm, 20mm, 25mm, 35mm

FJL Boards for Wide Range of Applications:
Tables and Countertops
Ceiling Panels
Stairs and Handrails
Accent Walls
Partition Walls
Shelves and Cabinets
Doors and Windows
Flooring
